name: Pylon
description: Customers waiting on a first response, with a nudge to the owner and then the team before Pylon's SLA runs out. Replies owed and tickets with engineering are one key away.

config.label: API token
config.help: Pylon → Settings → API Tokens. Under Act as user or bot, pick yourself, so the token has your access and no more, and the tab knows which issues are yours. It only reads; nothing is written back.

config.label: Your Pylon email
config.help: Only needed if the token doesn't act as you. Whose issues count as yours.

config.label: Sync every (minutes)
config.help: How often to ask Pylon for changes, 1 to 60. A new ticket appears at the next sync. Countdowns update every minute, and Pylon is checked again before any reminder, so answered tickets don't ping. Press r in the tab to sync now.

config.label: Remind the owner (minutes before the deadline)
config.help: When the issue's owner gets a banner, counted back from Pylon's first-response deadline. The owner is the assignee, or the account owner until somebody is assigned. 30 means as soon as it opens on a 30-minute SLA. Out of hours the deadline is next morning, so this is next morning too.

config.label: Remind everyone (minutes before the deadline)
config.help: When everyone running the Pylon tab gets a banner, counted back from the deadline. Everyone gets another at the breach. 5 means 25 minutes in on a 30-minute SLA.

config.label: Notifications
config.help: on or off. Banners come from macOS (listed as Script Editor in System Settings → Notifications) and don't follow StackNudge's mute. Off keeps the tab and stops them.
